title: Tiny, cute teddy bear
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- ears -->
    <circle cx='30' cy='34' r='10' fill='#b5651d'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='34' r='5' fill='#e8a87c'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='34' r='10' fill='#b5651d'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='34' r='5' fill='#e8a87c'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='22' fill='#c9772e'/>
    <!-- muzzle -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='12' fill='#f2c89a'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#5a3210'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='42' cy='43' r='3' fill='#2b1a0a'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='43' r='3' fill='#2b1a0a'/>
    <circle cx='43' cy='42' r='1' fill='#ffe9c9'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='42' r='1' fill='#ffe9c9'/>
    <!-- mouth -->
    <path d='M50 56 Q46 61 44 59' stroke='#5a3210' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M50 56 Q54 61 56 59' stroke='#5a3210' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#c9772e'/>
    <!-- belly -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='10' ry='10' fill='#f2c89a'/>
    <!-- arms -->
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='76' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#b5651d' transform='rotate(20 30 76)'/>
    <ellipse cx='70' cy='76' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#b5651d' transform='rotate(-20 70 76)'/>
    <!-- feet -->
    <ellipse cx='38' cy='94' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#b5651d'/>
    <ellipse cx='62' cy='94' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#b5651d'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='94' r='3.5' fill='#e8a87c'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='94' r='3.5' fill='#e8a87c'/>
  </g>
</svg>
